question: Which brand has the highest margin (gross minus net) in Europe?

answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  SUM(s.gross_amount) - SUM(s.net_amount) AS gross_minus_net
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON s.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE
  c.continent = 'Europe'
GROUP BY
  p.brand
ORDER BY
  gross_minus_net DESC
LIMIT 1

value: All sales lines (both physical and online channels, all time, no period restriction per Order.period default) joined to customers whose continent = 'Europe' in dim_customer. Europe is determined by the customer's continent, because continent exists only on dim_customer — no continent column exists on dim_country, dim_store or dim_location. No store trading-state filter applied (the question is about a sales figure, not about stores themselves, so Order.channel.both applies per Store.channel ruling). No customer active/registered filter applied (joining on customer_key to sales lines, so only customers who actually bought are included).
